oil.when: 2023 (service interval reset in Vehicle settings on the infotainment screen)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
With the vehicle parked and switched on, open Vehicle settings on the infotainment screen.
Switch off and on again and check that the Service interval or Service required message no longer appears.
oil.note: Checked in the 2023 Sportage owner's manual. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected or run flat.
